table.name: TLGNR_PLANT_BS
table.description: Supply plants from where products can be taken (Lieferwerk). This contains actual production plants (Produktionswerk) as well as places where materials are just stored. Plants dont necessarily correspond to real, physical plants, e.g. S106 (Externe Lager Zementverkauf) is a virtual plant and cannot be located geographically.

column.name: PRODUCTION_PLANT
column.description: Set, if the plant is actually a production plant. Reason to know this: Identical products are only identical if they have been produced by the same plant. The 'production plant' is generally a property of the material (where it was produced). From a logistical point of view, the plant of the shipping point is called the 'supply plant', regardless if it actually produced the material as well or not.

column.name: SAP_INVENTORY_MANAGED
column.description: Not used by Logon, sent to SAP Order interface in the field supply_plant_not_inventory_managed (value of flag is inversed when sending).

column.name: COORD_LAT
column.description: Latitude coordinates of the plant. Null: Plant is not a real plant / cannot be located geographically.

column.name: COORD_LON
column.description: Longitute coordinates of the plant. Null: Plant is not a real plant / cannot be located geographically.

column.name: STORAGE_LOC_BAG_IN_TRANSIT
column.description: Stock in transit storage location (SAP Virtual Storage Location) to be used for the goods movement process for Bag type materials.

column.name: STORAGE_LOC_BULK_IN_TRANSIT
column.description: Stock in transit storage location (SAP Virtual Storage Location) to be used for the goods movement process for Bulk type materials.

column.name: STORAGE_LOC_MIX_QUALITY
column.description: Mixed qualities storage location to be used for the goods movement process if the user choses that the returned quantity belongs to the mixed qualities storage location.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.

column.name: ETRAN_FLAG
column.description: Set to 1 if this is a Russian delivery plant with rail connection, thus needs the Etran input fields in the rail tab.
